C4rXLz3xRva.content:
different culture -> same God

All glory, honor & praise be to Jesus! TYJ for a new perspective & new beautiful relationships! 
I have been staring at this post trying to figure out how to describe this trip & what God is doing In Nicaragua…but I don’t think I will ever be able to explain it! 
getting to worship with my brothers & sisters in Christ, even though we don’t speak the same language has been so life changing! there is so much more to this world and this life than what we see everyday in America! I am so grateful for the sweet people I got to meet and work alongside with! 

This week I have learned:

• the Lord is so worthy to be praised no matter how we live and how great our circumstances are because there are people who have nothing that are still standing praising the Lord! 

• no matter who you are, how you live, what you look like, where you live, what language you speak, God is still the same! 

• what we have here on earth is SO temporary! as far away as eternity seems sometimes God & his love is forever! 

these sweet precious kids graciously give some of the only things they own to somebody they just met as a way of welcoming you, they go to class in 100° heat and no AC, possibly get the only meal they will eat that day at school, all with no complaints & smiles on their faces!  These kids showed me how Jesus loves and that it is not dependent on your circumstances or what you have!

Today I celebrate our Independence Day, the birth of America, the day that we established our sovereignty from under the tyranny of the British government, and set new bar of what freedom means for the rest of the world.

DC478MvSMIj.content:
When I was a kid, I stayed outdoors until sunset. Rode my bike to places and distances no young girl should travel alone. I played with stray cats. Loved to dig in the dirt for worms. Helped the neighbors garden. Took any opportunity available through Girl Scouts and church to camp. I found peace in the outdoors because my home environment had always been toxic. Being outdoors was where I found peace. The outdoors has always felt like home. 

I remember one time at band camp…No, sorry. Wrong story... 
I remember one time at church camp I found a baby toad. I tried and tried to catch it. Wasn’t happening. A bunch of kids were near by and one caught it for me. I was happy to have the little guy, but I wanted to catch it on my own. I tried on and off over the years. I cld never catch one. 

Fast fwd through life when I was disconnected from nature until I found rockhounding.

Then it happened. While out collecting I saw the cutest toad. No, this wasn’t the first time I had seen a toad since I was a kid nor while collecting. It was just the right time. I wanted to catch it so bad. I was with a friend and he encouraged me to catch it. Sounds silly, right? How hard is it to catch a frog or toad? I had convinced myself that I cldnt do it. Idk if I was afraid that I’d smush the little guy while attempting to catch it or if I harbored defeat since attempting as a child? I think I said I cldnt do it like 3x. Lol But the encouragement was enough to convince me that I cld. And I did. 

This was the moment I caught a toad for the first time! Again, I know this sounds silly, but it’s something I’ve always wanted to do. And it brought me immense joy. 
I will always remember this moment. 

It’s the little things that sometimes give us the greatest joy. It’s the little things y’all. 
The little things.🐸

#innerpeace #naturelover #nature #explore #toads #outdoorsy

DVj3a-1Emlx.content:
We’ve become so tied to electronics that now some of us are literally wearing them on our faces—glasses that record our daily lives.

But have we really stopped to think about what that means?

Those devices can capture everything we see… walking into batting cages, entering bathrooms, putting in prescriptions, bathing our children, or even bathing ourselves.

Are we considering how much exposure we may be giving away by constantly recording our lives? Who ultimately has access to that data, and how secure is it?

Technology can be powerful and useful—but it also requires awareness and responsibility. Before we normalize recording every moment, we should be asking deeper questions about privacy, safety, and who might be watching?

DKVACwRxv00.content: https://www.millionreasons.run/fundraisers/michaelfulcher ——PLEASE READ TO THE END—————-I’m a proud girl dad! But many of you may not know is I have 4 Daughters!  Morgan ❤️, Sydney ❤️, Lily ❤️, and Grace ❤️🕊️. Yes Lily is a big sister!! Grace unfortunately is not with us but she has a place directly on my heart and I see her everyday!! This month my amazing wife and I decided to join the Million Reasons Run. These runs are Canada with and for the month of May they raise funds for research, services and support for Children Hospitals across Canada.  We run for St-Justine in Montreal but more over I run for the memory of my little girl!!! She never made it into our arms but she was the strongest of all of us. In spite may catastrophic birth defect’s underdeveloped limbs and organs…she had the strongest beating heart 💓. She is one of my inspiration along with her mother and sisters.  It seemed a simple decision based on odds and all the risks to her and her mother that ending the pregnancy made sense.  But Marie-Eve and I had may questions and did not take this lightly. We wanted to hold our little miracle the doctors and nurses at St- Justine. We’re patient, kind and understanding or our will to bring our daughter into this world…all during the peak of Covid.  Eventually we believe we did the right thing.  With two day left I had 17 km to complete my goal of 150km running in May. My amazing wife completed 250 yesterday mind you she does have a treadmill in her office 😉. This morning the last day I had 11km to complete. I ran a hard 7 km then took a break. Went back out determined to finish for my little girl. But cramps, fatigue and terrible wind and ran left me feeling very weak. That’s when I saw her on the side of the road. She has visited several times during the years reminding me I CAN!! I got the energy I needed and even put another extra km for good measure.  I cried for part of the run after that. But they were happy tears!!! 🥲 Because I’m a girl dad, even when I can’t I’m reminded of why I can.  Thank for reading if you got this far…and if you can please donate or join us next year!!! I love you Grace…Daddy did it ❤️🫶🏻♾️🕊️.

POLICING OF THE KING ST BRIDGE MARCH FOR GAZA

Naarm-Melbourne CBD - 3 August 2025

On Sunday 3 August, thousands of protestors attended the weekly Free Palestine rally in the Naarm-Melbourne CBD, starting at the State Library before marching to the King Street bridge. Legal observers from Melbourne Activist Legal Support (MALS) were present from 12pm until 4pm.

These are our concerns -

1. MALS noted an excessive police presence at the King Street bridge, including the PORT and Mounted Branch. MALS estimates over 100 uniformed police, 40 PORT officers and 18 Mounted Branch units, as well as other resources such as trucks, a helicopter and a boat, were present at the King Street bridge.

The significant police presence was stationed at the bridge well before any protestors arrived, highlighting the pre-emptive nature of this policing, aimed largely at controlling and restricting the movement of protestors before they’d even arrived.

2. Armoured PORT and uniformed units were observed with VKS Pepperball guns, Baton round launchers, batons, shields and OC spray unholstered and ready to use, significantly and unnecessarily escalating tensions between police and protestors.

These “less lethal” weapons have the potential to cause serious injuries to people exercising their fundamental right to protest, as well as being used as pre-emptive tools for threat and intimidation. MALS has previously reported on the danger of these weapons.

The deployment of these weapons at this protest was entirely inappropriate and excessive. This is particularly concerning noting the significant number of families and children present.

CfSG95ZPvYr.content:
E.4.T. “Everything for Taurean” a short documentary.

While this doc is on its festival tour I wanted to share some frames of it with you all, this is a project over 3 years of making with director @nisinson and the golden net foundation here in Brooklyn. 

A story of a basketball Player local in Brooklyn who used the game of basketball to bring family, friends, and a community closer together. Before we started filming Taurean sadly had passed away on the basketball court from a heart attack, leaving his new born son and partner, family and community behind. The family and community that he supported and helped so much rallied around his passing and started a tournament to always Remember him, they now seek to change the name of the park to Tauren spears park. 

Thank you to everyone who could be apart of this project. It was such an honor to be able to lens this piece for everyone and help continue Taurean legacy even after his passing. 

Thank you to @jcomfy @sachibahra @jenn.zar @nisinson @meilinbae @arsalaandp any anyone else I am forgetting in this post for helping us on this project. And thank you to @brooklynfilmfestival for showcasing our premiere

D.P. @gezess 🐊 

Had an absolute blast on this one. The concept for the shoot was to recreate the old 80’s/90’s late night infomercials. Famous ones like Miss Cleo, the chia pet, or Oxy clean. 

We approached the lighting using only units found in that era as well. No LEDs, no wireless or remote gags, I wanted to immerse the whole set in creating something in the time period. We also used rear projections for our backdrops instead of an LED wall as well. 

Director @loicmagik was absolutely brilliant in the frames and creating such an over the top and fun energy with each of the operators of the hotline as well as our lead! 

Shot on the Alexa 35 with cosmetic textures and vintage 27-300 K35 zoom provided by @ransomrentals and camera support and accessories from @cptrental 

Thank you to everyone who was on this one. It was so much fun.

What can I say.  We are winners.
There’s a lot of hard work involved.
There’s a lot of hatred.
Hardship.  Loss.  Pain.  Doubt.  Disappointment.
All of these things work against the grit of a hockey organization at every level.
I joined as a substitute for #HabanerosHockey.  I didn’t know what impact I would be able to make, but I said I would try my best.  Then I got called up.  Got my sweater.  Played hard.  Didn’t make it all the way that season.
Picked up some friends.  Brought them up with me.  Practiced together.  Drank LOTS of beers together.  Cheered on the @flapanthers together.  Still went to that grind every Sunday.  Paintballers know where I’m coming from.
Then we got cut short.  Again.  I got mad.  Even hostile.  I wanted more out of what I put in.  I asked - nah, @btodhunter would say I demanded - to step up to forward.  I put up some production this season.
But then we hit some brick walls.  Some injuries.  And I was put back where I was needed - on defense.
Sometimes you’re not going to be the man of the hour.  You’re not going to get the touches.  You’re gonna get hurt.  You’re going to lose SOMETHING, if not the game.  But if you do your job, better than others do theirs, you have a shot.  There’s possibilities in the discipline of sports if you never give up.  And after all that - after every time you laced up to skate, pretended you were at a game 7 of the @stanleycup finals and it was all on you, the hours late at night that it was just you and your thoughts on the ice, all the travel, the hangovers, the late nights sometimes, missing friends, being lonely - what does that all get you at the end?

This.

This feeling right here, baby.  The feeling that hard work really does pay off.  The feeling that you have conquered a small mountain of impossibilities.  Doing it with your friends from way back and from yesterday.  Doing it in front of your family.  Doing it for those who couldn’t.  And it means the fucking WORLD to me that it’s with this team.  But you know what they say right?

RUN THAT SHIT BACK

CiWBZ5GumO4.content:
Há uma crença de que precisamos mudar o treino só porque "o músculo se acostumou", ou porque enjoamos. 
Será que a culpa é do treino ou da como treinamos?

Com: @karololiveira.__
Em: @ct.paulocampos

A elevação pélvica é um dos exercícios para glúteos mais importantes.

Porém para extrair o máximo proveito há um longo caminho passando por alogamentos, fortalecimentos, correção de desequilíbrios (como pés e quadril), desenvolvimento da técnica e controle adequado da carga.

Mesmo após as correções,  é comum culpar o treino pela falta de evolução, quando na verdade a questão é de como o treino é feito. Há intensidade suficiente? 

Quanto a intensidade, podemos incluir:

✅ Carga: intensa o suficiente para exaurir o músculo sem comprometer a técnica e os alinhamentos. 

✅ Concentração: a mente focada só no músculo, na cadência, na técnica.

✅ Intensidade: o quanto de força concentramos no músculo alvo até a falha ou próximo a ela. 

☑️ Vídeo 2, feito com intensidade, porém o mais comum: desistir ao achar que vai falhar.

✅ Vídeo 1, feito com mais intensidade: quando acha que vai falhar tenta mais 1, 2, 3 repetições 

Lembrando que a intensidade não deve comprometer a técnica e a integridade articular.

MANGUITO ROTADOR.

Se você se preocupa com Manguito mas nunca avaliou funcionalmente tuas escápulas, além de perder tempo "aquecendo", ainda continua expondo os ombros a lesões e dores crônicas. 
" Ah, mas o ombro tá ruim " - Assim como joelho, problemas nos ombros são consequências e não causa. Agir nos ombros só piora ou cria um problema que não estava lá. 

Será que existe um músculo chamado Manguito rotador? 
Não existe um músculo chamado manguito rotador.

Manguito Rotador é um complexo de quatro músculos que agem sobre o ombro, tracionando o Úmero em quatro vetores opostos contra a cavidade glenoide, cuja principal função é estabilizar a cabeça do Úmero dentro da Glenoide para, assim, evitar impactos ósseos e compressões irregulares na articulação do ombro, além de luxação e deslocamento. 

Resumindo, MANGUITO ROTADOR é um complexo muscular que cria uma força compressiva ao redor da cabeça Umeral, a estabiliza em todas as direções e ajuda a centralizar a cabeça Umeral na centro Cavidade Glenoide 

Ou seja, se a Função Principal do complexo do manguito rotador é Estabilizadora, por que seria uma boa idéia submetê-lo a uma fadiga e estresse mecânico precoces, quando esses músculos precisam prover estabilidade e segurança articular, não em um, mas em vários exercícios e atividades diárias?

Mesmo que fizesse sentido, porque fatiga-lo só em uma de quatro direções, causando mais desequilíbrio entre essas forças?

"Lesões não Traumáticas ocorrem quando um sistema de estabilização Ativo (muscular) falha em dissipar carga no sistema de estabilização passivo (articular)" - ( PROTETTI, Ricardo).
Se uma das principais razões para a falha muscular é a fadiga, seria realmente útil " aquecer " manguito antes do treino, o fatigando e expondo a falha? Pense nisso.

Mas Manguito rotador não trabalha sozinho, para ser capaz de cumprir sua função ele depende de uma boa ancoragema na cintura escapular.

Mas, ESCÁPULAS e suas disfunções, será assunto para outro momento.

Os exercícios de costas se dão em fases distintas. É preciso preparar as escápulas, a base de ancoragem para o manguito rotador. Isso provê segurança articular aos ombros e eficiência, nao só ao treino de costas, mas a todos.

Abaixo, texto de autoria do Prof. Eder Lima 

"Todo e qualquer movimento da cintura escapular deve começar por uma ação sobre as escápulas, seja estática ou dinâmica"

NEUTRO - os porquês!

O que são Escápulas em Neutro?
É o posicionamento das escápulas em situação que NÃO HAJA nenhuma depressão, elevação, abdução, adução, rotação superior ou rotação inferior.

Por que colocar as Escápulas em Neutro?
As escápulas em neutro criam uma base estável para os movimentos dos ombros por favorecer a ação dos músculos do manguito rotador

Quando usar as Escápulas em Neutro?
Todos os exercícios de membros superiores começam pela colocação das escápulas em neutro, exceto no caso das puxadas onde as escápulas partem de uma posição elevada, mas a finalização destas é em neutro.
De ser usada também em qualquer exercício de membros inferiores que exija sustentação de carga pela cintura escapular, como Stiff, Levantamento Terra e etc.

1. Altas repetições: Vamos começar pela pior opção. Altas repetições nunca é boa opção. Esforço repetitivo sem carga é justamente uma das principais causas de LER, seja tendinopatia, tendinite, bursite, osteofitose. Se você somar rotinas de trabalho, disfunção escapular ou postural, e até posição de dormir, é possível que o aluno tenha um alto estresse mecânico sem tempo de recuperação. "-Ah, mas e se não há dores ainda?" Pode ser que esse seja o 1% que falta para o desastre, ou leve aos 99% e um copo d'água seja o 1% que faltava. 

2. Mais carga, menos repetições. Pode até ser uma boa ideia caso você saiba o que está fazendo. Lembra-se daquele 1% que falta para uma lesão crônica? Pois é, o aluno está em recuperação? A cintura escapular está estável, garantindo um espaço articular adequado nos ombros e pronto para traballhos de força? Se sim, certamente é melhor, ou menos pior do que 10, 20 ou 30 repetições sem carga. 

3. "Depende": Depende do tipo de dor, tipo de lesão. É por impacto articular? Por movimento repetitivo? Por má postura? Tem origem na coluna cervical ou cintura escapular? Às vezes, uma boa instrução ajuda, outras vezes (quase sempre) é preciso intervenções pontuais, como clínica,  por exemplo 

4. Sem Treino: A maioria das vezes essa será a melhor opção, parar os treinos de deltóides (ombros),  principalmente se você não sabe a origem da dor, tampouco os tecidos envolvidos. É importante ressaltar que Ombros são sempre vítimas, não a origem dos problemas, logo, tem que se rever rotinas e se intervir em estruturas adjacentes enquanto se deixa os tecidos articulares se recuperarem. Afinal, diferentemente dos músculos, a recuperação de tecidos conjuntivos, tendões, ligamentos, bursas e ossos levam dias, meses ou anos. 

Conclusão: Dores nos ombros: 
Dor nos ombros, não treine, ache a causa, trate. Se o diagnóstico permitir treinar, prefira poucas repetições e carga segura. Busque ajuda clinica, boa orientação, boa avaliação funcional - não é avaliação antropométrica,  essa não permite personalizar e dar segurança aos treinos.

Principais erros na Remada T e como evitar:

Pouca inclinação: Diminui a ativação dos músculos dorsais e limita os resultados, pois redireciona a cargaparao trapéziosuperior.

Falta de controle do movimento: Movimentos rápidos ou descontrolados podem comprometer a eficiência do exercício, diminuindo o tempo sob tensão do músculo alvo.

Controle das escápulas: Não controlar bem as escápulas reduz a ativação muscular e aumenta o risco de lesões, uma vez que boa parte da tensão vai para outras partes. 

Instabilidade ou desalinhamento da coluna: Coluna mal posicionada ou instável pode resultar em dores e lesões graves.

⚠️ Melhorar a execução desses pontos é fundamental para evitar problemas e maximizar seus ganhos. Avaliação funcional e treino adequado são indispensáveis para corrigir essas falhas!

💦 A Importância de Beber Água Durante os Treinos 💪

1. Reposição de Líquidos Essencial: Durante o exercício, o corpo perde líquidos e eletrólitos (sódio, potássio, cálcio e magnésio) pelo suor. Repor é fundamental para o bom desempenho .

2. Ajuste de Temperatura Corporal: A hidratação ajuda a dissipar o calor gerado pelo esforço físico, evitando superaquecimento.

3. Efeito na Performance: Estar hidratado garante um fluxo sanguíneo adequado, oxigenação muscular, controle da frequência cardíaca e melhora do desempenho.

4. Como se Hidratar:

Antes do Exercício: Beba 500 ml de líquidos com sódio cerca de 2 horas antes do treino.

Durante o Exercício: Beba líquidos a cada 15-20 minutos sem esperar a sede.

Após o Exercício: Reponha o volume perdido em até 4-6 horas para manter o equilíbrio hídrico.

5. Monitoramento da Hidratação: Cheque a cor da urina e, se possível, avalie o peso pré e pós-treino para monitorar a perda de líquidos.

👉 Dica: Nos dias quentes, aumente a ingestão de água antes e durante o treino para evitar riscos maiores.

DDXBm72Ok86.content:
Tríceps paralelo na Máquina: será que você faz certo?

Na Articulação do ombro há muitos tecidos que atravessam o pequeno espaço subacromial, que é o espaço entre o úmero e acrômio (ossos do braço e escápula).

Quando os ombros estão instáveis ou descentralizados, aumentam as chances de compressão ou impactos nesses tecidos e, consequentemente,  aumentam a possibilidade de diversos tipos de lesões, desde bursite até desgastes ou crescimento ósseo irregular,  ou mesmo rompimento de músculos como o supra espinal e ligamentos ou tendões como do Bíceps, sem contar desgastes da própria cartilagem capsular dos ombros. 

Esse exercício para tríceps,  como outros,  pode parecer ingênuo,  mas se feito errado com muita frequência ou muitas repetições,  aumenta as chances de lesões e/ou dores crônicas nos ombros. 

A estabilização e centralização dos ombros começam pela avaliação e correção das escápulas.

Lembre-se,  musculação não é só músculo. Segurança vem em primeiro lugar.

The St. Lawrence Market Complex, which includes St. Lawrence Hall and the North and South Market buildings, has served as a City landmark for more than 200 years and remains one of the most valuable historical sites in Toronto.

The North Market building was underutilized and did not maximize the full potential of the St. Lawrence Market Complex. The redevelopment of the North Market building will improve the utility of the St. Lawrence Market Complex for vendors, visitors and shoppers, while contributing to the economic development of the area.

The St. Lawrence Market North building will host its first Saturday Farmers’ Market on April 5.

A Special Grand Opening Community Event will follow on May 10.

The courts at the new St. Lawrence Market North building are open.

The original St. Lawrence Market South building, open six days a week, will continue operating with its current vendors, offering countless opportunities to support local businesses.

DSWfCa-iWBJ.content:
#GRESHERDATEDAY

The Robert McLaughlin Gallery
Oshawa, Ontario

Special Exhibition
Curator: Alyssa Fearon
Artists: Ekow Nimako

Building Black Civilizations: Journey of 2,000 Ships continues artist Ekow Nimako’s afrofuturistic reimagining of ancient African kingdoms. Using LEGO bricks as his medium, Nimako explores the mysterious fourteenth century sea voyage of Mansa Abu Bakr II, predecessor of Mansa Musa, ruler of the ancient Mali Empire. According to legends, Abu Bakr II was an intrepid explorer, who abdicated his throne and took 2,000 ships on an expedition into the Atlantic, but was never to return or heard from again. Some accounts suggest the massive fleet reached as far as the Americas, but where they went beyond this is still unknown. Combining architecture, historical accounts, and fantastical possibilities, Nimako transcends the geometric form of LEGO to recreate the epic voyage. And in doing so, Nimako presents an uninterrupted and unco-opted narrative of Black civilizations and imagines liberated futures.

DS8SsnCESS2.content:
GHANA TOUR 2025 VLOG 3
Join us on our epic ancestoral discovery, cultural education, spirtual connection and lifestyle tour of Ghana... Accra, Cape Coast & Ada... 

Standing in this place where so many of my ancestors were brought here against their will. 
I have a lost for words and my heart goes out to all those who lost their lives here, on the ships and who made it across the Atlantic to the west.

Elmina Exploration
Elmina Castle (Slave Dungeon) & the Elmina fishing community
Gold Coast

Elmina Castle (Dungeon) in Ghana, built in 1482 is one of the oldest buildings in Africa.  Infamous as a major hub for the transatlantic slave trade for 250 years, where hundreds of thousands of enslaved Africans were held in horrific conditions before being shipped to the Americas through the "Door of No Return". Now a museum, it serves as a powerful memorial and educational site, operated by the Ghana Museums and Monuments Board, attracting tourists and descendants seeking to understand this dark chapter of history. 

Dungeons held vast numbers of captives in cramped, unsanitary conditions, leading to disease, with the "Door of No Return" being the final exit to slave ships.

Women were repeatly taken advantage off by workers, soldiers and even the govenor who had a private staircase to his quarters... 

You can read about this in books, watch movies but your life will change when you see it for yourself!!!

DJgdfk7soCq.content:
أنا وصنع الله ابراهيم
بدأت علاقتي بصنع الله ابراهيم منذ سنوات الثانوي حيث كان ذهني قد بدأ بعد  يتفتح للأدب ولقضاياه  فتراني أبحث بين طيات الروايات التي أقرؤها عن صدى لما يعتمل في صدري وذهني من مشاعر وأفكار مبكرة عن الخير والشر والحق والعدل . ثم وقعت بين يدي رواية اللجنة. فقرأتها وأعدت قراءتها مرات، إلى أن شارفت على التماهي مع بطلها. تحدثت تلك الرواية بما في نفسي وأشارت بشجاعة لسيطرة النظام الواحد ووجهت أصابع الاتهام بقلم جريء لإمبريالية أمريكا دون مواربة وإلى علاقتها بالأنظمة المحلية العميلة لها، صنيعتها ،فانبهرت أمام هذا الكاتب الشجاع وبدأت أستزيد من القراءة  له  وعنه.  وعرفت رفضه للمصانعة ورفضه للجوائز حين تتبناها أنظمة استبدادية، وعرفت عناده وشعرب به يسير في مسالك الإبداع والأدب ذئبا منفردا لا يتردد في خسارة رفاق أو معارف أو أصدقاء إذا كان قربهم يتقاطع مع الحق. عرفت أن هذا النموذج هو الذي أحب أن أقرأ له وأتعلم منه. 
عرفت أن صنع الله ابراهيم هو المثقف النقيض لنموذج المثقف صنيع السلطة الذي تصطفيه وتبجله وتفرضه على مناهجنا الدراسية وتدفعه إلى ساحة النجومية مقابل أن يكون بوقا دعائيا لها أو مقابل أن يسكت عما يجري لشعبه وعما تفعله به تلك الأنظمة.
أحببت صنع الله ابراهيم دون أراه وأحببت قبضته الرمزية التي يشرعها في وجه  الباطل . وظل واحدا من أبطالي وأبا من آبائي الروحيين إلى أن كتبت أولى رواياتي، سنتها عاهدت نفسي أن أظل وفية لنهج صنع الله ابراهيم وأن أظل ذئبة وحيدة قابعة دوما على يسار السلطة  لا أتبع نظاما ولا أصفق لأحدا ولا أكتب لجائزة ولا أوالي أنظمة تعتقل الأدباء وتحبس الشعراء باليمين ثم تبيض وجوهها بجوائز مبهرة باليسار.تشهرها أمام المبدعين كجزرة أمام حمار. 
عاهدت نفسي أن أجتهد ما استطعت وأرتقي بقلمي ليكون إبنا وفيا مخلصا لنهج صنع الله ابراهيم الجريء الذي خاض مسالك التجريب منذ عقود ولم يهب ناقدا ولم يكف عن مساءلة الذوق العام وخلخلته. 
شفاء عاجل لك يا أستاذ صنع الله ابراهيم. شفاء عاجلا لك يا معلمي. شفاء وسلاما ومودة لا تموت أبدا.

🌷قصة قصيرة جدا من "وريقات في  سيرة هانّا"

في حياة أخرى كان إسمي هانّا. كنت أنتظر ملّاحا طوّافا على المواني
يغزل الحرير لحسناوات بلدان الشمال الباردة وينسج أجنحة الفراشات للأرامل في بلدان الشمس الحارقة ويصنع الشوكولا من جلودهن. كنت انتظره مع  ابنه الصغير جوشوا وأفتش على خبر منه  في وجوه الملاحين العائدين على ظهر كل سفينة  جديدة ترسو.
صار ابننا شابّا يرفض اصطحابي في وقفة انتظاري المعتادة، ويفضّل المبارزة بالسيف في الغابة المجاورة والمقامرة بعمره من أجل  خصلة من شعر إبنة الخوري.
صرت أحتاج الى شال ثقيل أدثّر به كتفيّ وضباب كثيف أُمنّي نفسي بخيال شبح سفينة تخترقه حاملة الي ملّاحي. صرت أحتاج الى عصا أتوكأ عليها. ويحدث أن يرافقني ماكسيم ابن جوشوا وهو يمسك بيدي ويحاذر ان يفلتها حتى لا أسقط منه.
صرت أنسى لماذا أحضر في هذا المكان كل مرة ترسو فيه سفينة.
أقف مدهوشة أمام هذا الأزرق الكبير وانا أتلفع بشالي وأحمل عصا لا أعرف كيف أستخدمها أحيانا.
صرت أتجمد على الشاطئ ولا أعرف طريق العودة حتى يأتي شاب لطيف مع طفل صغير ويمسكاني بلطف ويذهبان بي إلى بيت نظيف دافئ فيه سرير مريح وشابة طيبة تحسن العناية بي.
نسيت كل شيء تقريبا ماعدا شبحين يتراقصان على الشاطئ ويضحكان ملء الرئتين وفراشة بيضاء صغيرة تشاطرهما الفرح والرقص على ذلك الشاطئ

جمعت بينهما الروح النسوية المتوثبةوفرق بينهما الاختيار الفني، فيينما اختارت الكاتبة التشيلية ،وهي من هي، ، أن تعدد أخبار النسوية وإحصائياتها بطريقة تقريرية  مملة تكلمت عنها سابقا في منشور خاص بها ،اتخذت حنبن الصايغ اللبنانية في أول تجربة روائية  لها أن تعلي راية النسوية بنفس الحماس والقوة لكن دون ضجيج ودون شعارات. اختارت رواية حياة نساء الدروز من الجدة إلى الأم إلى الحفيدة  واختارت لها بنية حكي وتقنيات جعلتني أستمتع بذلك الحكي وهي تفكك قضايا المرأة الدرزية  وترصد معاناتها  وصراعاتها وكينونتها وسط مجتمع رجالي بامتياز.
القارئ يريد أن يشعر بالدفء الإنساني في الأدب. يريد أن يرى تشريحا لتلك النفس البشرية يمكنه من فهم نفسه أو النظر في مرآة الرواية ليفهم مجتمعه وما طرأ عليه من تغييرات دون أدلجة عنيفة. تعلق القارئ بالشخصيات وخلجاتها هو ما يعطي للقراءة متعتها وللأدب إنسانيته . ويجعله خالدا 
ملخص هذه المقارنة أنه يوجد في النهر مالا يوجد في البحر.

وهج الأسماء الكبيرة المكرسة قد يحجب ضعفها ووهن منجزها الأدبي أحيانا ويحجب عنا أسماء جديدة غير معروفة تقدم لنا التجربة الإنسانية في أجمل تجلياتها حتى  وهي في أشد لحظاتها بشاعة وحلكة.

في سنوات سابقة خضت تجربة الدوبلاج الصوتي للصور المتحركة ،ثم اقترحت على صاحب شركة الانتاج عليه رحمة الله، أن ننتج سلسلة  تلفزية للمراهقين وقدمت له النص .

 ولأنني أستاذة بالأساس انتقيت مجموعة من تلاميذي وحدثت أولياءهم في الأمر ثم أخذتهم معي إلى شركة الانتاج لمقابلة المنتج ولشرح المشروع كله.ولكن لأسباب يطول شرحها أجهض المشروع الفني، غير أن  واحدة من تلميذاتي اللواتي اخترتهن أصبحت فيما بعد ممثلة من جملة  الشباب "المؤثربن" الذين استعان بهم منتج تونسي معروف جدا في مسلسلاته ، فأخذت الفكرة والقصة والشخصيات والإطار الزماني وكل التفاصيل وأنتجت هي المشروع دون أدنى إشارة لصاحبة المشروع الأصلي .

والقصد من سرد هذه الوقائع أن السارق لأنه فارغ لا يستطيع أن يواصل الإبداع ولا يقدم شيئا جديدا ،وهذا ما حصل مع تلميذتي فعلا.

والنتيجة أن المرء يعيش وبموت وهو يظن قدراته كلها تقتصر على حركة واحدة يقوم بها في مصنع أو على مكتب أو أمام نصبة خضر في سوق ما مثلا
نحن مقاطعون بشدة لمبدإ الارتقاء بالذات ،بل نحارب من يحاول أن يكتشف قدراته . وهذا شعرت به حين بدأت الرسم والنقد السينمائي ( سخر الكثيرون من ما أفعله  وشككوا حتى في شهادتي الجامعية ( ماجستير الفنون المرئية)😅 طبعا ازدريهم جميعا وأواصل بنائي لذاتي ،لكن السؤال يبقى برسم المنظومة التعليمية وبرسم الأولياء المسؤولين أساسا عن تكوين شخصيات أبنائهم وتقديم ما يمكن تقديمه لهم ليستطلعوا ذواتهم ومهاراتهم المختلفة مع الوعي بأن رحلة اكتشاف الذات والتعلم واكتساب المهارات الجديدة لا تتوقف أبدا.

و للأجيال الجديدة التي لم تعرف من هو  المناضل الذي فرحنا بإطلاق سراحه اليوم
 جورج ابراهيم عبد الله، أقدم سجين سياسي أوروبي
لد جورج ابراهيم عبد الله في 2أفريل 1951 في بلدة القبيات شمال لبنان، لعائلة موارنة ماركسية. عمل معلما في مرحلة ما قبل الجامعة، ثم انخرط في الأوساط القومية العربية المؤيدة للقضية الفلسطينية. تحالف بداية مع الجبهة الشعبية لتحرير فلسطين، ولاحقا أسس الجناح المسلح الثوري اللبنانني عام 1979.
هو "مناضل ضد الامبريالية" وربيبتها"الصهيونية". اعتُقل على خلفية تورطه في سلسلة اغتيالات استهدفت أجهزة المخابرات الأمريكية والإسرائيلية في باريس بين عامي 1982 و1984. وأدين في 1987 بالسجن المؤبد نتيجة دوره في اغتيال كلا من الضابط الأمريكي تشارلز راي، والدبلوماسي الإسرائيلي يعقوب بارسيمانطوف، مع محاولة اغتيال قنصل أمريكي آخر .

القبض والمحاكمة

اعتُقل عبدالله صدفة في ليون، فرنسا، أكتوبر 1984،

في عام 1987، صدرت عليه أحكام بالسجن المؤبد بتهمة التورط في عمليتين اغتيال ومحاولة اغتيال.

السجن وطلبات الإفراج

كان مؤهلاً للمراجعة منذ 1999، لكن طلباته للطلاق رُفضت باستمرار لأسباب سياسية وأمنية، كما أن دولًا عدة، منها الولايات المتحدة وإسرائيل، ضغطت لاحقًا لمنعه من الخروج .

في نوفمبر 2024، حكمت محكمة فرنسية بالسماح بإطلاق سراحه شرط مغادرته البلاد، لكن نيابة مكافحة الإرهاب استأنفت القرار.

CZvEkE_BCNR.content:
It’s been weeks since mum passed 🙏
I thought I should give a special thanks to my friend @kevoparsons @yahgenfurnitureau for the painting representing mums passage through life with her large extended - “every colour of the rainbow family”, as she put it. Also Kevin for arranging @colinappo to do a beautiful emotion and funeral site cleansing ceremony, with smoke and didgeridoo. It was a unique service thanks to that and the fact a top shelf piper on the bagpipes as escort walking her to and during the departure of the hearse. Absolutely amazing and she definitely would have approved. It was interesting to see that cute little chapel in the greenest of valleys, by the idyllic pond. After driving through blinding rain it was suddenly clear, the moment we got there - perfect day. And when she passed with her final breath, our sisters left the hospital only to see a rainbow form right before their eyes. My son laughed and said it was Grandma letting us know “she made it”…. Merely coincidence for most, but as we grieve we attach our emotions to so many things. Like the cicadas suddenly now noticeable as tears run down my face, the connection to nature as real as ever thanks for sharing mum. 
My sisters and brother shared just a few of our many treasured memories that evoke every emotion. A common thread being the physical and cognitive resilience, a tale of a woman of substance who shared herself without hesitation nor expectation. Times change more rapidly than expected and it is now our turn to be the older generations. Can’t express enough gratitude for the simple nature based teachings you passed on to us all mum…❤️
She was no angel but she had a heart filled with the capacity for absolute fearlessness, ferocity, passion and loving nurturing ways. Providing for us so well that poverty was never a problem, it was cruelty, heartlessness, corruption and greed among other negative things that she despised. 
-
-
Hope you enjoy the gifts of our love and gratitude for your eternity mum, yes the special ones too… 🌻 
As it was at your creation, nature now embraces you again as her own. 🌹

Today is the day God was crucified.

Beaten. Mocked. Nailed to wood by the very people He came to save.

No angels called.
No power flexed.
Just obedience… unto death.

This is what love looks like.

The Cross isn’t decoration.
It’s an execution.

And Christ didn’t die so we could stay comfortable.

He died to pull us out of sin, out of death, out of ourselves.

Every lash… for us.
Every drop of blood… for us.
Every breath… given willingly.

“It is finished.”

Not defeat.
Fulfillment.

So today isn’t about feeling good.
It’s about remembering what it took.

Silence.
Reverence.
Gratitude.

Because before the Resurrection…
there was the Cross. #HailChrist  #ChristisKing

- 1.5 bottles of your favourite #TrueBrew beer -  3 cups (750 ml) water (for the slow cooker) - 2 cups (500 ml) brown sugar - 1 bay leaf - Pepper

PREPARATION:
1. With a knife, remove the rind from the ham.
2. Place the ham in a large pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes to desalt it. Drain.
3. Place the ham in a large slow cooker. Add the remaining ingredients. Season with pepper. Cook for 7 to 8 hours on high temperature or until the ham is fork tender. Turn the ham over halfway through cooking, if possible.
4. Keep the pan juices for cooking delicious whole potatoes.

Enjoy!

Been a minute. Almost a year off social media. I must say time off has been fulfilling to say the least. 

3 years ago life set me on a path of solitude. Initially I had know idea what was happening until a year ago. I recognized it was happening internally, whatever “it” was. Not a book worm but I always found comfort in reading. This past year however, it’s been mind opening. These have been my favorite maybe I read them while being intentional if that makes sense. 

“The Power of Now” helped me identify my Ego, which I found has been on auto pilot my whole life. So much bs in my past derived from it. Also released me from the clutches of my past and future but rather see the peace in the here and now. 

“The Alchemist” taught me purpose. So long have I struggled finding my own or even what purpose was. I complicated it so much thinking it’s all about desires and wants, money & material things smh. Probably my all time favorite.

“Who Moved My Cheese” A simple book but has so much depth. So much meaning. It’s about 2 mini people and 2 mice trapped in a maze in search of cheese lol like huh? But in their journey identifies the type of people and their behaviors today. There’s lessons  on fear, complacency, unwillingness to change, visualization, foresight, visualization, risk, belief and so on. Dope book.

“How to Win Friends & Influence People” so many 💎 in this book. My biggest takeaway is the power of positive reinforcement, being kind. One of my favorite excerpts “The greatest asset I possess, and the way to develop the best that is in a person is by appreciation and encouragement”. 

 Someone used to say to me years ago “you’re on a journey my friend”. Had no clue what dude meant. But back on it I go. Wanted to post some true substance. Samara Kimiko I miss you daily sis ❤️

DRAkoBZkWkq.content:
Today is #WorldKindnessDay and I’m so grateful for the community of people who follow me on this page. 
Thank you to everyone who runs into me at various events and comes over to chat! 🫶🏽
Here are a few ways to spread kindness in your community:

1. Send a sweet message to someone and put a smile on their face. Everyone loves a genuine compliment. I’m a huge fan of mailing thank you cards and sending random text. 
2. Give someone the benefit of the doubt. I always choose to think well of people with good intentions. It prevents me from overthinking or thinking the worse. It also prevents wrinkles. 
3. Let someone go ahead of you: In Houston traffic, at the check out line, at the airport…. Let’s be patient with each other.
4. Put in a good word. I love good gossip in a quiet way. Finding out that people are looking out for me without my knowledge always melts my heart. 
5. Be open to others. We have new people arriving to our city all the time: new jobs, new neighbors, new friends. While people figure out the culture of our very social city, be flexible to learning new perspectives. 

Lastly, smile! Pat yourself on the back for everything you’ve pushed through. It’s been quite a year! Be kind to YOURSELF, you’re doing a great job. 💋

jaminose.historical_summary: The account centers on skateboarding life and local community, especially a serialized “40 years on this Useless Wooden Toy” memoir, “Thrasher Thursday” magazine retrospectives, Youstabrand events, board releases, mini-ramp jams, skate demos, PNW/Montana road trips, kayaking, and personal milestones. The writing is casual, nostalgic, and heavily shout-out driven, using skate slang, apologies for long posts, and dense tags/hashtags. Emotionally, it is overwhelmingly warm, grateful, stoked, and sentimental, with brief grief over a pet and self-deprecating humor. The user prefers community-oriented interaction through tagging friends, brands, and photographers, thanking supporters, and sharing multi-part stories.

CvKgC-MuWEL.content: A grinding stone excavated from an archaeological site in southern Vietnam was used to prepare spices. Microscopic traces of plant material found on the stone included traces of turmeric, ginger, clove, cinnamon & nutmeg. One seed still produced the familiar smell of nutmeg after 2000 years. The site, Oc Eo, was a city that lay at the crossroads of a trade route that spread to the Mediterranean Sea. These same ingredients are still used in curries today. Interesting to note, coconut was also found at the site. Curry recipes have remained relatively consistent throughout time.  Cultural trade between Southeast Asia & South Asia created a cuisine with lasting appeal-Evidence of time honored deliciousness. You should definitely make some for dinner! #curry #coconut #vietnam #southeastasianfood #traderoutes #smellssogood #archaeology #cuisine #celebratefood

This was a fun, sweet, and spicy workplace romcom!

In this story, we have workplace rivals who both earn spots on a 3-week company leadership retreat to Hawaii. Trishara, who is over qualified and under utilized, earned her spot because the company has a poor record of promoting women and even more so women of color, and it was kind of a cop out. Rafe, also won a spot, but he’s the CEOs son, so did he even earn it? 
Either way, when they get to the resort, there’s a booking error, and there’s only one beautiful suite left —and of course it has only ONE bed!! 
Might these two learn to work through their rivalry or might they make this dream trip an absolute nightmare for everyone there, because they are torturing everyone with how bad they have it for each other?!! 

It’s so fun, so flirty, and I loved the banter. I legit wanted to shake Trishara at times, but I know her heart was mending from trauma that happened years ago. I wanted to shake Rafe at times too, cause jeez Louise! That man needs to learn how to set boundaries with the people in his life. 

One thing I loved about Trishara was how she memorized all the smiles that Rafe revealed and each one was different. I loved how Rafe was so protective of her and empowered her, building her confidence. He praised her!

kallitecpatl.historical_summary: KALLI TECPATL publica principalmente en español e inglés para difundir su cultura azteca/mexica: clases virtuales tipo Escuelita, campamentos presenciales, Día de Muertos, danzas, lengua náhuatl, cocina ancestral, arte, historia, ofrendas y eventos comunitarios. Su estilo es cálido, espiritual y promocional, con saludos recurrentes como “Piyalli” y “Saludos mi gente/comunidad”, emojis, hashtags y frases motivadoras como “Tiahui/pa'delante”. La emoción predominante es orgullo cultural, resiliencia, gratitud e invitación comunitaria. Prefiere interacciones por DM para registro, preguntas, becas, lista de correo y enlaces en bio, además de pedir contribuciones para programas juveniles.

DUuR7OWigld.content:
🌋✨ Lost in the lunar landscapes of Lanzarote's volcanic caves! 🌿 As I hiked around the iconic Cueva de los Verdes and Jameos del Agua, these resilient succulents caught my eye, thriving in the harshest conditions imaginable. Picture this: black lava fields from explosive eruptions in the 18th century (like the Timanfaya volcanoes that blanketed the island in ash between 1730-1736), relentless trade winds whipping through, scorching sun, and barely 150mm of rain a year. Yet, life finds a way!

These plants have epic adaptations to survive the arid, nutrient-poor volcanic soil that's super porous but rich in minerals. Many use Crassulacean Acid Metabolism (CAM) photosynthesis—opening stomata at night to save precious water during the hot days. Deep roots or mulch-like ash layers help trap dew and moisture from the air.

Spotlight on a few stars:

Aeonium lancerottense (endemic to Lanzarote!): These rosette-shaped succulents store water in their thick, fleshy leaves, blooming with delicate pink and white star flowers in summer. They've evolved to handle extreme drought and wind, often perching on rocky lava outcrops.

Euphorbia balsamifera (Tabaiba Dulce, Lanzarote's official plant symbol): A shrubby endemic with knobby stems and latex sap that deters herbivores. It clings to dry slopes, adapting to low water by shedding leaves in tough times and regrowing when conditions improve.

Aloe vera: Not native but perfectly at home in the volcanic terrain—its gel-filled leaves are a natural healer, and it flourishes without much irrigation thanks to the ash's moisture-retaining magic.
Nature's toughness here is inspiring—reminds me how we can adapt and thrive too! Have you braved Lanzarote's volcanic wonders?

DUvNxyujeiB.content:
🌋✨ Hi, from the magical depths of Lanzarote's volcanic caves in Cueva de los Verdes 🌅

Stepping into places like Jameos del Agua and Cueva de los Verdes feels like entering another world—ancient lava tubes formed by the eruption of Volcán de la Corona around 4,000-5,000 years ago. These incredible tunnels stretch over 6 km long (one of the longest volcanic tube systems on Earth!), with parts extending 1.5 km underwater as the legendary Tunnel of Atlantis.

The harsh volcanic history of Lanzarote shaped this surreal landscape: massive eruptions created vast lava fields (malpaís), extreme aridity, and nutrient-poor soils. Yet, nature and human ingenuity thrive here! César Manrique, the visionary artist, transformed Jameos del Agua in the 1960s into a stunning art-nature fusion—think emerald pools, a turquoise seawater lake filtered through the rock, lush gardens, and even the world's only auditorium carved inside a volcanic cave (seating 550!).
Unique facts that blow my mind:

The crystal-clear subterranean lake hosts the tiny, blind, albino crab Munidopsis polymorpha—an endemic species found nowhere else on Earth! These little white dots adapted to total darkness and the brackish water over millennia.

"Jameo" comes from the ancient Guanche language, meaning natural roof collapses in the lava tube that create open caverns letting in dramatic light.

The caves served as natural shelters historically—locals hid from pirates, and shepherds used them for refuge.

The play of golden sunlight filtering through the collapsed sections, reflecting off emerald-green waters and rugged black lava... it's pure magic and a reminder of how beauty emerges from fire and time. Lanzarote's volcanic soul is unreal! 🔥

DVgnF0JjQwD.content:
The Southsea hovercraft (operated by Hovertravel) is such a cool piece of British engineering history! 

🚀🌊 Here are some fascinating facts about this iconic Solent crossing:

It's the world's only year-round commercial passenger hovercraft service still running today – and it's been going strong since July 1965 (that's over 60 years!). No other place in the world offers scheduled hovercraft trips like this all year round.

The route zips between Southsea (Portsmouth) and Ryde (Isle of Wight) in just 10 minutes – the fastest way across the Solent from land to land, no piers needed!

Hovertravel started with leased SR.N6 models seating just 38 passengers, and now runs modern 12000TD craft that carry more people comfortably (including bikes and mobility scooters).
Invented by Sir Christopher Cockerell in the 1950s (who tested the idea with a coffee tin and cat food can!), the first cross-Channel hovercraft trip happened in 1959 – but Southsea-Ryde became the enduring success story.

It's not just for tourists – commuters love it for the quick, direct shore-to-shore ride, plus easy connections via the Hoverbus to Portsmouth trains and city centre.

Who's up for a ride across the Solent on this floating legend? ✈️💨

✈️ Taking to the skies once again — 90 years after its legendary first flight!

This beautiful two-seat Spitfire (registered BS410), painted in the iconic light blue-grey colours of the original prototype K5054, is setting off from Southampton Airport today on the first leg of the Spitfire 90 UK tour.

On 5 March 1936, test pilot Joseph “Mutt” Summers took off from this very airfield (then Eastleigh Aerodrome) in the prototype Spitfire, famously saying after landing: “Don’t change a thing.” Designed by local genius R.J. Mitchell, the Spitfire went on to become one of the most iconic aircraft in history and a symbol of freedom during the Battle of Britain.

Now, exactly 90 years later, BS410 is embarking on a special 9-leg circumnavigation of Great Britain (7–17 April), visiting historic RAF bases and overflying key Spitfire sites, with modern RAF aircraft joining in formation for parts of the journey.

A true tribute to British aviation heritage. What an incredible sight! 🩵

El año 2025 me enseñó que nada se pierde: todo se transforma.
2025 fue un espejo… aveces suave, aveces incómodo, pero siempre honesto. Me recordó que la vida no se detiene para esperarnos: nos invita a despertar, a abrir los ojos, a elegirnos de nuevo.
Cierro este ciclo con el corazón más claro, con la intuición más fuerte y con la certeza de que cada paso, incluso los que parecían retrocesos, me estaba llevando a un lugar más auténtico.
Gracias a cada señal, a cada límite, a cada renacimiento, a mi alma por seguir caminando incluso en los días donde todo pesaba.
Por las sincronías que me recordaron que la energía siempre guía.
Por cada persona que se fue… y dejó espacio para alguien más auténtico.
Por mi intuición, que nunca me ha fallado cuando me atrevo a escucharla.
Por todo lo que me transformo, incluso cuando no sabía que lo necesitaba.
Por cada “NO” que me protegió. Por cada “SÍ” que me abrió caminos. 
Por los retos que me enseñaron a confiar más en mi magia que en mi.
Por las conversaciones con mi alma que solo el silencio me permitió escuchar.
Por las lecciones que no pedí, pero que igual me hicieron más sabia.
Gracias a mi, por no apagarme.

DEt8mIwSUPP.content:
Have you seen paradise lately? 😍 

The drive into Lamington NP was so beautiful, the higher up you get, the cooler it got, the more dense the foliage became with a fantastic rainforest feel. All the rain has made this place come to life. The drive in was just as spectacular as the falls.

The hike down the Border Track had a few different options, we took one of the shorter day hikes across the Tree Top walk which was fun, circles back onto the Border Track and to Picnic Rock, probably about 8km all up. Picnic Rock was the first stop, and a nice spot to take a snack break and then a short walk to Elabana Falls..............

What a beautiful sight to behold, these falls were alive with beauty and I was so pleasantly surprised at the majestic feel, so many little waterfalls leading up to the main fall, with much surrounding greenery, it was simply stunning. Met a few little leechy friends, 3 all up haha, but got them off fairly quickly & was lucky enough to have a bird come and land on my shoulder, that was magical, check out my reel where you'll also see a blue Lamington Crayfish 🦞

What a wonderful walk, ended by coffee and great food at the O'Reillys Café.....highly recommend the Pumpkin Arancini balls.....delish.

ND64....dreamy....handheld.....even better!

Earlier this week was an early start for sunrise down at Binalong Bay, the weather was terrible, extremely windy (41km), very high crashing tides, rain set in, but what a morning to get some amazing photos.

This not the location for sunrise, in-fact I was driving home, hanging for a warm coffee and to get out of wet clothes and boots, but then this scene sprung on me. It would have been rude to keep driving and not get the shot!! So much going on, but it works.

DKzG1C9Sy69.accessibility_caption: a windy and rainy morning along the east coast of tasmania. The orange stained rock, the burnt coloured grass blowing viscously in the wind, two seagulls flying towards me against the wind, mountain silhouetted in the distance with cumulus cloud forming thick and heavy. to the right of the scene a rainbow appears in front of a greay smooth cloud, so much so the rainbow looks like it was painted in a blank grey canvas. DK4IXdLSVdS.content:
Doing a recce, no tripod or filters as the sun was setting, so no time to fluff around. I was fighting the last light and wind and found a sweet spot. Had shot a F-stops I would not normally to get a little tiny long exposure, but it works, IS is obviously not too bad on this beast of a camera.

High tide and an entertaining sky, what a place to live!!

When I looked at the tide, it said 1m.....I am so used to NT high tides of 7m haha

macmichaelvalerie.historical_summary:
Valèrie Macmichael’s posts centre on Australian landscape, coastal, wildlife, and travel photography, especially around Tasmania, the Gold Coast, Sydney, and Darwin, with frequent details about Nikon and OM cameras, lenses, NISI filters, long exposures, weather conditions, hikes, whale watching, homecoming, and small-scale growing projects. The writing style is warm, conversational, and enthusiastic, often using emojis, rhetorical questions, humour, and reflective commentary about nature, patience, and creative opportunities. Emotionally, the posts are positive, grateful, nostalgic, and excited, with occasional frustration about weather or missed shots but a strong sense of joy and resilience. Interaction preferences include tagging brands, locations, and fellow accounts, using extensive photography and travel hashtags, mentioning competitions and feedback, and encouraging viewers to look at additional images or reels.
Accounts this user follows often involve political commentary, surveillance concerns, and privacy advocacy.

Ilan Pappé é historiador e académico israelita, conhecido internacionalmente pelos seus trabalhos críticos sobre a história de Israel e o conflito israelo-palestiniano. Ao longo de décadas, destacou-se por desafiar narrativas oficiais, defendendo os direitos dos palestinianos e denunciando práticas de colonialismo e limpeza étnica. O seu livro mais influente, “The Ethnic Cleansing of Palestine” (2006), analisa detalhadamente a criação do Estado de Israel em 1948, argumentando que a expulsão em massa de palestinianos foi um plano deliberado de limpeza étnica, e não apenas um efeito da guerra.

No excerto que se segue, apresentado no Congresso Anti-Sionista em Viena, em Junho de 2025, Pappé analisa a responsabilidade histórica e contemporânea da Europa Ocidental na criação e manutenção do Estado de Israel, e o impacto dessa política sobre os palestinianos. A sua intervenção aborda temas como o “complexo judeu europeu”, a indiferença europeia perante o genocídio em Gaza, e a ligação entre o racismo europeu histórico e as políticas atuais no Médio Oriente.

A Lahore-based businessman, who was kidnapped by armed men during a home invasion, remains missing a week later as multiple law enforcement agencies have also denied having him in custody.

Syed Masood Hassan Rizvi, a resident of Valencia Town, was allegedly kidnapped by armed men during a late-night intrusion at his home on April 1. The case was registered with Kahna police under Section 365 of the Pakistan Penal Code (PPC), which pertains to kidnapping or abduction with intent to secretly and wrongfully confine a person.

While officials from the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA), Punjab Police and the Crime Control Department (CCD) have clarified that Rizvi is not in their custody, this marks the second time in six months that he has gone missing.

In October 2025, Rizvi had disappeared for about a week before reappearing. At the time, his family was informed that he had been in the custody of Factory Area police in connection with a monetary dispute. He was released after securing bail from the high court.

In the latest incident, Rizvi’s wife, Sumera Syed, said that she was having dinner with her husband and their son at around 11 pm when armed men entered their home.

DACaj-ySI9L.content:
Dear Community,

For the past few years, I’ve had the honor of sharing breath work, cold plunges, and healing practices with so many of you. What began as a personal practice and a way to support myself has grown into something far bigger than I could have imagined.

However, I’ve come to realize that in pouring into others, I’ve forgotten to refill my own cup. The last two years have taken a toll, and I’ve been giving from a place of exhaustion. As much as I love helping others, I can no longer continue at this pace without first giving myself the space to heal and reconnect with my own practices.

With this in mind, I’ve decided to take a break from hosting workshops and events for the rest of the year. This isn’t a goodbye forever, just a necessary pause to focus on my own well-being, spend time with friends and family, and rediscover the joy that brought me into this work in the first place.

For those of you who have already given me deposits or have something booked with me, I will honor those events as I wind down my practice. I appreciate your patience and understanding during this time.

I won’t be active on social media during this period, as I feel the need to step away and create some space for myself. I encourage everyone to take moments for themselves as well, because sometimes the greatest healing comes when we step back and allow ourselves to simply be.

Thank you for all the love, and I’ll see you when the time is right.

With gratitude,
Miguel

DWEm6lTkwiK.content:
Quran 4:145 Tafsir Ibn Kathir
The Prohibition of Wilayah with the Disbelievers Allah forbids His believing servants from taking the disbelievers as friends instead of the believers. This includes being friends and associates of the disbelievers, advising them, being intimate with them and exposing the secrets of the believers to them. In another Ayah, Allah said, لاَّ يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْكَـفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ اللَّهِ فِي شَىْءٍ إِلاَ أَن تَتَّقُواْ مِنْهُمْ تُقَـةً وَيُحَذِّرْكُمُ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ ( Let not the believers take the disbelievers as friends instead of the believers, and whoever does that, will never be helped by Allah in any way, except if you indeed fear a danger from them. And Allah warns you against Himself ). meaning, He warns you against His punishment if you fall into what He has prohibited. This is why Allah said here, أَتُرِيدُونَ أَن تَجْعَلُواْ للَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَاناً مُّبِيناً ( Do you wish to offer Allah a manifest Sultan against yourselves ) meaning, proof against you that warrants receiving His torment. 
Ibn Abi Hatim narrated that Ibn `Abbas commented; سُلْطَاناً مُّبِيناً ( manifest Sultan ), "The word Sultan in the Qur'an means proof. " There is an authentic chain of narration for this statement, which is also the saying of Mujahid, `Ikrimah, Sa`id bin Jubayr, Muhammad bin Ka`b Al-Qurazi, Ad-Dahhak, As-Suddi and An-Nadr bin `Arabi. The Hypocrites and the Friends of Disbelievers are in the LowestDepth of the Fire, Unless they Repent Allah then states that, إِنَّ الْمُنَـفِقِينَ فِى الدَّرْكِ الاٌّسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ ( Verily, the hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire; ) on the Day of Resurrection due to their tremendous Kufr. Al-Walibi `Ali bin Abi Talhah said that Ibn `Abbas said, فِى الدَّرْكِ الاٌّسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ ( in the lowest depths (grade ) of the Fire;) means, in the bottom of the Fire. Other scholars said that the Fire has ever lower depths just as Paradise had ever higher grades.

C41pQ6CuhnU.content:
Another life saved!! Cecal Volvulus>>dead bowel.  A colonic volvulus occurs when a part of the colon twists on its mesentery(blood supply) resulting in acute, subacute, or chronic colonic obstruction. The main types of colonic volvulus are sigmoid volvulus and cecal volvulus. This was a case of cecal volvulus. 

2 conditions must be present for the development of a cecal volvulus: (1) an abnormally mobile segment of cecum and colon and (2) a fixed point around which the mobile segment can twist. The second condition occurs by normal ileocolic (small to large intestine) attachments, but also by  abnormal adhesions( scar tissue) after surgery or appendicitis.

Large back Lipoma excision under local anesthesia. Patient awake for this in office procedure. - Lipomas are the most common soft-tissue tumor. 
- slow-growing, benign fatty tumors form soft, lobulated masses enclosed by a thin, fibrous capsule. 
- Hypothesized to rarely undergo sarcomatous change. 
- More likely are at benign end of the spectrum of tumors, which, at the malignant end, include liposarcomas. 
- Mostly asymptomatic, but depends on location - treatment is complete surgical excision

DVasvxcEaCu.content:
PAXG & Gold Weekly: What the pullback really means 

A pullback after a fast rally is often not a “thesis break.” More often, it’s the market doing two things:

1) Repricing uncertainty
When geopolitical risk rises, markets add a risk premium.
When the situation looks less extreme (even temporarily), that premium can fade—prices retrace.

2) Repricing inflation expectations
Energy + shipping disruptions can lift inflation expectations quickly.
If growth slows while inflation stays sticky, that’s a stagflation-leaning setup—typically tough for stocks/bonds, and supportive for gold’s role as a strategic hedge.

3) Why PAXG is worth watching
PAXG can act like a sentiment thermometer.

Premium (above spot) can signal urgency / strong demand
Discount (below spot) can signal risk-off, forced selling, or liquidity preference
Practical takeaway

Don’t chase vertical moves
Use pullbacks to reassess thesis + risk
Track rates/liquidity alongside gold

DVhd8kDE04Q.content:
Starlink: Valuation Anchors on Cash Flow

Three Customer Types, One Logic
Starlink sells connectivity to consumers, enterprises, and government/emergency use cases, and recurring payments become cash flow.

Demand Is Strongest in “Extreme” Cases
Because it relies less on ground infrastructure, it reaches wider coverage and stays essential during outages, disasters, and in remote regions.

Price + Regulation: Hard Limits on Penetration
High pricing and hardware costs slow adoption, while regulation constrains rollout speed, so progress depends on capacity up, cost down, and approvals.

Launch × Starlink × Starship: A Potential Flywheel
Cheaper launches accelerate deployment, Starlink cash flow funds R&D and scale, and Starship maturity could step lift costs down again.

Ignore Noise: Track 4 Drivers
To judge the story, focus on whether the base can scale (user growth), pricing power (ARPU), execution speed (deployment cadence), and the margin path.

Biggest Risk: Misaligned Incentives
Investors price near-term delivery, founders may prioritize long-horizon reinvestment, and the longer the spend, the harder returns are to underwrite.

Execution & Pace: What Determines Delivery
What matters most is delivery speed, because cadence, capacity, and approvals determine when cash flow shows up—and if pace stalls, valuation stalls.

Starlink Tracking Checklist
We would track users and pricing, rollout milestones versus plan, and regulation plus key tech milestones toward commercialization.

DW8orYJOXVV.content:
The latest Fed minutes showed a shift markets can no longer ignore.

At the March meeting, some officials were already open to signaling possible future rate hikes, while many warned that higher energy prices could keep inflation elevated for longer. The Fed still left rates at 3.5% to 3.75%, but the tone was clearly less dovish than many investors had hoped.

That matters because the market story is changing. For months, the base case was simple: hold now, cut later. These minutes suggest the Fed is no longer thinking in such a one-way direction.

If oil stays high and inflation turns sticky again, the next debate may not be when cuts begin. It may be whether policy has to stay restrictive for much longer, or even tighten again.

That would raise pressure across the economy. Energy already squeezes households and businesses through higher costs. If the Fed also keeps money tight, the economy gets hit from both sides: costs stay high, but financing does not get easier.

That is bad for hiring, investment, housing, and rate-sensitive stocks. It also helps explain why the dollar can stay firm while gold faces a more complicated path.

So this is no longer just a story about delayed cuts. It is a story about whether inflation has pushed the Fed back into a defensive stance.

My Personal Juneteenth Celebration
Virgie Lee Small 
“Big Mama”

June 19, 1910 -November 23, 2013

Lineage By definition is a sequence of species who have evolved from its predecessor. The lineage of Nichole Johnson is strong, more so tantalizing. Not many people can say that they’ve touched three generations of their history, but also been present for five generations. 

These incredible women; Mattie Griffin, Virgie Lee Small, Hazel Lee Brown, Gwynneth Harris, and Nichole Johnson have established themselves as powerhouses in their own right. Mattie and Virgie survived slavery and went on to become pillars of strength and wisdom in their communities. 

As we celebrate Juneteenth today was already a national holiday in our household as it’s our Big Mama’s birthday. Born June 19, 1910 this date has an even more special meaning to our family. We share in this momentous celebration and toast to birth and freedom. Cheers!

Cl-wTl3ofJ6.content:
“In November 2020, just months before launch, @nicholelrjohnson discovered she had cancer too. “I was diagnosed with stage-two vaginal cancer, which requires aggressive treatment. And the whole experience was a real eye-opener for me because I learned, through my own experience and through speaking to other women, that women of colour, and black women particularly, are not listened to, not advocated for and not fought for as they should be, compared with other ethnicities.”

	Johnson’s answer was to found @RustyRabbitCares, a foundation raising awareness of, and funding for, cancer treatment and care for black women on both sides of the Atlantic. “In most countries, women of colour are the least likely to be listened to or believed when expressing their health concerns. So we want to help to challenge that system and give back.””
 
And that’s exactly what we’re going to do. We’re pleased to announce the official launch of our @rustyrabbitcares foundation today. Where we Party With a Purpose with the Rebel Rabbit Corps of @LapinRouille.  The vehicle we use to administer care and spread awareness to Women of Color. Head over to our website (link in bio) and learn more about our mission and how you too can become apart of our Rebel Rabbit Corps.

Excerpt taken from @fthtsi article written by @alicelascelles for @financialtimes. On newsstands today. #earsup

@hitboy killed this track for @rapsody called #asteroids (check her out) !!! Hearing it on repeat just gave me a Cypher vibe. DVtOdRkjNhW.content:
Yesterday, we brought workers, allies, and supporters to the front door of the NYC Restaurant Show at the Javits Center to deliver a clear message: if restaurants want to use our public sidewalks, they need to pay their workers One Fair Wage.

Actress @susansarandon joined workers on the street, spending an hour serving as a server in the cold to experience firsthand what outdoor dining really means for tipped workers and why they deserve a full wage for that work. Special thanks to @chefrjackson also! 

The City Council is deciding whether to make outdoor dining permanent. We say that decision comes with a responsibility. Public space is a privilege—no other industry in this city gets it—and restaurants that receive it should meet the standard every other business already meets: a full minimum wage with tips on top.

300,000 tipped workers are counting on the city to act. March 9 was our show of force, workers and allies, organized and visible, ready to win. #OneFairWage #RaiseTheWage #LivingWage

DVvzQQ4gW7j.content:
What IS a livable wage in 2026? @fmsmith319 did the math — and it's a gut punch.

At $15/hr, you're $790 in the hole every month just covering the basics. At $20/hr, you're "surviving" with $80 to spare. At $25/hr, you're finally "livable" — with $60 left over.

No debt. No kids. No luxuries. That's the bar for "livable."

The federal tipped minimum wage is still $2.13/hr. We can do better.

#OneFairWage #LivingWage #MinimumWage #EndTippedMinimumWage #FairPay #WorkerRights

DWmMbCRjh6f.content:
April Fool's Day is canceled because nothing about $2.13/hr was ever a joke. 

While the internet is busy with pranks today, millions of tipped workers across the country are heading into double shifts at two different jobs, hoping enough customers sit in their section and tip enough to cover rent this month. 

The real prank is a system that tells servers their labor is worth $2.13 an hour and then asks them to smile about it. The federal tipped minimum wage hasn't changed since 1991.

That's 35 years, eight presidents, and not a single cent more. 

That's why we're fighting to end the subminimum wage so no worker has to depend on a customer's mood to feed their family. 
#OneFairWage #AprilFools #TippedMinimumWage

Restaurant owners and workers alike have been waiting far too long for change. It’s time to raise the minimum wage, end the subminimum wage for tipped workers, and create a fair system that works for everyone.

Cw51KPqPD1z.content:
Absolutely devastated to hear of the loss of this man, someone who made such a big impact on me as a young person.

When I was in high school I had the opportunity to spend several years in Richard’s Black Music Ensemble. He always made it so clear what the music was really about from day 1.

He put me on to everyone. Coleman Hawkins, Wardell gray, Jon Hendricks… literally everyone. Without him, my foundation would not have been set. He put me on my musical path, and even wrote my letter of recommendation to MSM lol.

When I showed up to his UW class as a high schooler with a tenor saxophone, he told me to put it away and come back with a clarinet. He even called Eddie Daniel’s in the middle of class to chew me out for not learning clarinet.

He was a hard ass because he could be, and wanted to always get the best out of his students, and never let them forget what the music was about.

The knowledge, stories and music history riddles this man shared with us were endless. 

I could go on forever about his impact on me and so many countless others. 

I wish I could play him Coleman Hawkins solo from body and soul one more time. Back in the day he always told me it wasn’t quite right, “listen to it again”. Lol

He was an absolute GIANT of this music. 

I am forever blessed to have spent time learning this music from him. The true source.

Rest in absolute power Guru Ji 🙏🏽

CddC_-ajw_c.content:
Movements that go Vertically Down.
For us, this is Movement #2.
Unless you have great external rotation flexibility in your rotator cuff. I'd strongly advise to avoid this one if your just stating out.
I just personally don't see the benefit versus the risk to injury in this position. 
It's just too simple to sit slightly back and pull in front of you.
If you don't have to change your upright position when you pull behind your head, then jump on it.
You have been warned. 📝

Cde4ZA4oEQv.content:
Most newbies to the gym squat too heavy, squat too fast and don't go as deep as they can mechanically go.
I know I know ego's a bitch.
Gotta look good for IG💫
I was told not to squat again for safety of my knee but I just can't help trying it here and there.
But it forces me to behave. 
It forces me to be slow and believe it or not this was really damn hard for me.
(As @chris_strong_wong is still casually warming up at 125💪🏽🙌🏼).
I am personally pausing on the pins to release the tension in my knee (where usually the tension is at its greatest).
Most would advise to maintain tension the whole way through but I'm trying to reset at the bottom (like an Anderson Squat).
Anyway. Focus on working hard not heavy.
Heavy is a by-product of working hard...
Enjoy your training...

We’re just getting started. 2027 loading.

Sign up for that marathon, sign up for that powerlifting team, sign up for college… whatever you’re doing just go ahead and get it done.

DLQlRRjRNVT.content:
She wasn’t just a chef. She was the kind of person who listened when no one else was listening. The kind of person who acted quietly, without the cameras rolling, and without ever needing to be thanked. And now, as she leaves us, I feel like the world deserves to know a little more about the kind of soul we just lost.

During one of her seasons of Worst Cooks in America — I won’t say which one, or who it involved, because this was never meant to be a public story — something deeply human happened behind the scenes.

A fellow cast member was struggling. Really struggling. While filming, her life outside the show was unraveling — she was behind on her car payment, and her home was on the verge of foreclosure. She was trying to stay focused, smile on camera, and keep it together. But in a quiet moment, while talking to her family off to the side, her mic was still on. And Chef Anne heard everything.

Anne didn’t stop to ask production. She didn’t make it a storyline. She didn’t turn it into a teaching moment or a PR stunt.

She just made sure the bills got paid.

The cast member kept her car. She kept her home. And she never had to carry the shame or burden of that moment alone. Anne didn’t want applause. She didn’t ask for repayment. She just knew what the right thing was—and she did it.

That’s the kind of woman Chef Anne Burrell was.

Her talent was undeniable. Her fire, her flair, her humor—sure, the world saw that. But it was her heart that made her unforgettable. A heart that gave without needing credit. A heart that cooked with love, and lived with compassion.

She’s gone now. And maybe not enough people are talking about it. But I am. Because people like that deserve to be remembered.

Rest in peace, Chef Anne. The world may not have known all the lives you touched, but those who did will never forget. #chefanne

This is what a 100-mile wind hurricane looks like when it is NOT accompanied by rain, but instead has travelled across a hot desert, collecting tumbleweed and dry brush, before hitting a population that has not seen rain in nearly a year. Just one spark, anywhere in the city, becomes a blowtorch. This is what a perfect storm for fire destruction looks like.

Many want to find blame. No amount of firetrucks, garden hoses and brush clearance could have saved this from happening. I believe the only way we could have better prepared would have been to practically flood the city, dousing homes and hillsides with tens of millions of gallons of water, starting long before the high winds hit our city! But that’s not realistic and likely would not have truly helped anyway.

My heart goes out to all who have lost their homes, their cars and their cherished mementos in this apocalyptic fire. Los Angeles is strong and there is a lot of love here. We will, and already have, come together as a community to help our fellow Angelenos. 

If you are affected, please reach out to your friends and family for help. You are NOT a burden! You ARE cherished citizens of the earth, in need. Many of us feel helpless to aid you in this dire time, but we truly want to. Lean on us over the coming months for strength, help and shelter. 

I send all my love and healing energy your way. You are not alone. 🙏🏽❤️

#LAStrong

DEwLmySRBQZ.content:
To put things into perspective: The Los Angeles Fire Dept says that firetrucks are designed to handle 3 house fires at once. To keep up with the Palisades and Eaton fires last Wednesday, it would have required 26,000 fire engines, all spraying simultaneously – far more than the entire state of California even has! Even if every water source in the city were running at full capacity, it would have been impossible to supply enough water to fight all of these fires at once.
 
A friend who was caught in the Palisades fire stayed until he was forced to leave at the last possible moment. He told me that he could see several fire tornadoes jumping from house to house as he fled on Wednesday evening. Later that same evening the winds whipped up to nearly 100 miles per hour. So, at once we had both fire tornadoes and fire hurricanes burning through the community.
 
Malibu and the Pacific Palisades have some of the strictest building codes in the country. The Coastal Commission oversees building permits along the California Coast going as far inland as 5-miles in some areas. The Coastal Commission requires stringent fire and earthquake safety precautions in building methods and materials. Even that could not save the homes that were constructed under these strict building requirements (homes built after 2008).

To those saying the city should have done more—yes, perhaps it could have. But in the face of such extreme conditions, even the best efforts would only have delayed the inevitable. This fire was going to be THIS destructive! Man could be no match for mother nature in this case. Let’s hope this is a once in a 100-year freak incident. Unfortunately, we seem to be having once in 100-year freak incidents every single year lately.

There will be much analysis following these fires. There will likely be many more changes and even stricter building codes in the Coastal Commission going forward. I hope it is enough to prevent such a catastrophe in the future. Above all, my heart goes out to the Angelenos who lost their homes and I pray that soon they will ALL be ok.

DGZyj5lxEpN.content:
Growing up I was always athletic—track, gymnastics, cheerleading… And I could eat anything and not gain weight. People would warn me, “Be careful. You’ll get fat someday.” I thought, “Haha! Not me! Not a chance. I’ve got those special ‘good genes’!

Then I hit 50! The pandemic happened, and slowly… the weight crept on. One day, I stepped on the scale—THIRTY POUNDS UP! WTH?! (Ironically, the whole time I worked at Beachbody, I was steadily losing my “beach body”!)

I tried everything. Nothing worked. I figured, “Welp… guess this is geriatric life!” My last check-up, my doctor’s advice, “Lose Weight”! OMG! I asked him how I could do that. Doc said, “Eat less.” 😳 I looked into GLP-1s but wasn’t “fat enough” for approval. I researched and found a program called HERS—doctor-assisted weight loss with meds that curb hunger.

They recommended 75g of protein daily, but didn’t give any meal plan! So, I turned to ChatGPT! 😂 It helped me calculate my daily caloric intake to reach my target weight (1,375/day to lose). The amount of time needed to reach the weight safely AND maintain it (4- 1/2 months), and the amount of calories daily to maintain once I get there (1,975/day). It even built meal plans & a grocery list for me!

Four months later—I feel AMAZING! (I reached my goal a little early). I still eat everything. Yes, even cake & wine. I’ve literally had leftover cake or cookies for breakfast almost everyday since Thanksgiving! LOL! 😂 But portion control was my missing piece. It wasn’t my age. It was my consumption! 🐷

Now, I’m feeling stronger than ever. Ready to maintain. So… stay tuned.  Gonna start posting on @Cali_Fit_Chick again to keep myself accountable! Go check that heffa out! Let’s go! 🎉💪🏾

#WeightLossJourney #HealthyLiving #FitnessOver50 #GeriatricLife #PurpleHairDontCate @cali_fit_chick @hers

Little Lolita had her vet check-up Friday, and surprise—she’s not an old lady or a former backyard breeder after all! I knew I had to stop and check to see if it was alright and if its owner was around and frantically looking for it.

To the point where she is now a bit tubby and on a diet! But good for her, she never needs to wander the streets in search for food again. She’s getting spoiled by her childless dog mom!
